## Parent

#15

## What to build

Make declared `Audio` audible while previewing in the Player on Android, iOS, Desktop and wasmJs, behind one small internal interface, using a maintained KMP audio library if one aligns with our Compose versions and native players otherwise.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Audio plays during Player playback on all four platforms and stops on pause and at the end.
- [ ] Seeking repositions audio to the new frame's time.
- [ ] Volume and mute from the media declaration and the player apply.
- [ ] Export remains unaffected by the preview implementation.
- [ ] Each platform target compiles and at least Desktop is covered by an automated test.
